title: USC OIS: Post-Completion OPT (curated summary)
text:
USC post-completion OPT provides eligible F-1 graduates with up to 12 months of work authorization. The job must relate to the USC major. A job offer is not necessary to apply. Students must continue maintaining F-1 status and reporting to OIS.
USC OPT application sequence: confirm graduation eligibility with the academic department; request an OPT-recommended I-20 in Trojan International; receive it from OIS; then send Form I-765, that I-20, and the supporting materials to USCIS. USCIS decides the application and issues the employment authorization document (EAD). Begin work only after receiving the EAD and reaching its start date. Report employment and address updates through Trojan International.
USC OPT eligibility includes an academic year of maintained F-1 status and restrictions involving prior OPT and full-time CPT. The official page contains separate OIS request deadlines, USCIS filing windows, and I-20 timing requirements. This summary does not enumerate those deadlines or current fees; consult the application page before filing and ask OIS about individual circumstances.
